verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says the product includes an "AI-powered expense assistant" and AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, so a built-in assistant exists. The evidence is a single thin marketing mention with no detail on what tasks a user can hand off to it. The MCP server serves external AI assistants, not a built-in one, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's delegable tasks and how users interact with it, scope beyond expenses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Save time with AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments.
